LOCK A BUYER, EXIT OR REPAYMENT PLAN BEFORE THE SWIPE, STACK 0% INTRO CARDS, AND NEVER FLOAT MORE THAN THE CASH IN YOUR BANK ACCOUNT
site_ui.lead: Practitioners run buying groups, gift card resale and the interest-free card float as a points engine: they buy capped items on their own cards for thin 2-5% spreads, line up a buyer at an agreed rate before every swipe, and never float more than their bank balance.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, and every claim carries timestamped inline attribution to its creator and video. Coverage runs from buying-group mechanics, gift card liquidation and float economics through approvals, account shutdowns, issuer card stacks, portal stacking and premium fee math.

flow: Season bank relationships for 30 to 60 days, space 0% intro cards six months apart, and target long 0% windows before scaling spend
Commit to the deal before researching it, since reservations hold only 12 to 24 hours, then match the exact SKU and log every order in a spreadsheet
Keep orders between $500 and $1,000, split carts, pay through PayPal, Apple Pay or Shop Pay, and rotate backup addresses and names
Ship only to addresses the group posts, ignore Discord DMs from 'admins', and never resubmit failed orders or return unsold items
Confirm a buyer at an agreed rate before buying promo gift cards, send $100 through any new route first, and weigh 5-6% liquidator fees against 2-3% invoice routes
Collect the ACH reimbursement, clear charge cards every 30 days so interest never accrues, and report sales at or above the 1099-K total under the matching EIN
